display_name: llama.cpp (a CUDA build you compiled yourself)

support.note: NVIDIA GPU, CUDA 12 driver; the architectures are the ones the build was compiled for

notes: Any llama-server built from source with CUDA, with its libggml/libllama libraries in the folder beside it (`library_dir: binary`).
{device} is llama-server's own device name (`llama-server --list-devices`: CUDA0, CUDA1, ...). CUDA_DEVICE_ORDER=PCI_BUS_ID makes CUDA0 the same card nvidia-smi calls 0.
Measured 2026-11-13 on a Tesla P100 through lemond built from lemonade-sdk/lemonade#3906; see BACKEND_DEFINITIONS.md.
